_comment: Hand-maintained context that doesn't come from either spreadsheet: our own internal target platforms and the marketed reference product used as a benchmark. Edit this file directly when these change (e.g. a target concentration is revised) -- it feeds into dashboard_data.json the same way the two xlsx files do. 'deal_id_aliases' lets a deal row in Deals_News_Feed_source.xlsx (matched by its Technology ID) attach to an internal target instead of being treated as an external technology -- used here because 'thermicra_unconfirmed' was an early tracker entry later corrected to be internal-only.

internal_targets.name: H-Cure
internal_targets.mechanism: Internal high-concentration reformulation program. Shown here as our own benchmark target against the external competitive landscape, not a third-party licensable technology.
internal_targets.mechanism_ko: 내부 고농도 재제형 프로그램. 외부 경쟁 환경에 대비한 자사 벤치마크 목표로 표시한 것이며, 제3자에게 라이선스 가능한 기술이 아니다.

internal_targets.name: Thermicra
internal_targets.concentration_text_ko: 약 380 mg/mL — 내부 프로그램 목표 농도(근사치).
internal_targets.mechanism: Second internal high-concentration reformulation target, tracked alongside H-Cure as a benchmark against external platforms.
internal_targets.mechanism_ko: 두 번째 내부 고농도 재제형 목표로, 외부 플랫폼 대비 벤치마크로서 H-Cure와 함께 추적한다.

reference_products.name: Dupixent (reference product)
reference_products.concentration_text: 150 mg/mL (300 mg/2 mL prefilled syringe/pen, commercial presentation)
reference_products.concentration_text_ko: 150 mg/mL (300 mg/2 mL 프리필드 시린지·펜, 상용 제품 형태)
reference_products.mechanism: Current marketed dupilumab formulation — a conventional liquid + excipient formulation with no concentration-enabling delivery technology. Included as the benchmark comparator for this landscape.
reference_products.mechanism_ko: 현재 시판 중인 두필루맙 제형 — 농도를 높이는 전달 기술 없이 통상적인 액상과 부형제로 구성된 제형이다. 본 경쟁 환경의 기준 비교 대상으로 포함했다.
